Name: Content Patcher - Fixed Mouse House
Author: thingwithwings
Description:
[size=3]This mod is 1.6 compatible!! Update incoming to fix a minor error in smapi, but everything should work fine as-is :)

I decided to create my own version of a 'fixed-up' Hat Mouse House, and I made it work for content patcher, since just editing the outdoors tilesheets actually broke other visual mods I use haha
[/size]I may update this with other colors or a brick house version if anyone wants to see them!
[size=3]
Update 1.0.2:[/size] If you are updating the main file please delete the old folder first, as I changed the folder name and it will [b]not[/b] overwrite the previous version! The new version of the Toned Down SDV Conversion should overwrite the old one just fine, and now it also has the update key! In addition a possible bug with the content.json was fixed.


EDIT: Major thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26612284]INFECTMEINJECTME[/url]﻿ for allowing me to upload their edited version as an optional file! 
[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
